column1: # conf/node-tasks.tsv — the ONE table of a node's loops: which runs ONCE for the
# machine and which once per login (issue #3546, EPIC #3500 C1). Every launchd
# template (launchd/com.claude-fleet.<unit>.plist.tmpl) and every task / child of
# the node daemon's machine table (bin/fleet-node-supervisor.py default_table) has
# exactly one row; bin/fleet-machine-tasks.py table --check reds on a loop with no
# row, and on a row naming nothing (BREAK-IT per-login-machine-loops).
#   kind    unit (a launchd template — the node daemon runs it for each login it
#           manages) | machine (the daemon's machine table, run once)
#   class   machine — the same answer for every login, so the machine computes it
#                     ONCE (a login reads the result: cluster/machine.json)
#           login   — needs the login itself: its tmux server, its gh token, its
#           session — a login loop that only serves the login's live sessions
#                     (issue #3671): the daemon runs it only while the login's
#                     collector publishes a session count above 0
#                     keeps no such process. No count, or a stale one ⇒ it runs.
#   what    one line: what it does and, for a login loop, why it cannot be the machine's
# A new loop is a new row, and its class is a decision: a machine row's answer
# must not depend on whose it is. A login loop that also probes the machine reads
